item.title: [Legacy] Mac check: iPhone Duo PR #372 (inner and cover screens)

labels.name: host: mac
labels.description: Needs the maintainer's Mac (Xcode, legacy app, live captures)

item.body:
### Context
PR #372 (branch `legacy/duo-inner-cover`, base `master`) puts the iPad split view on the unfolded iPhone Duo and keeps the tab bar on the cover screen. It was written in a Linux container with no Xcode: **nothing has been built**. This issue holds the checks for a Mac.

### 1. Build
```sh
git fetch origin legacy/duo-inner-cover && git checkout legacy/duo-inner-cover
set -o pipefail
xcodebuild -project SuperHFRplus.xcodeproj -scheme HFRswift -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build 2>&1 | grep -E "error:|warning: .*(MainWindow|Common|MessagesView)\.swift|BUILD SUCCEEDED|BUILD FAILED"
```
Expected: `BUILD SUCCEEDED`, with no new warnings in `MainWindow.swift`, `Common.swift` or `MessagesView.swift`. If SwiftLint is installed, run `swiftlint` on these files: 0 new warnings.

### 2. Simulator or device: iPhone Duo **open**, portrait then landscape
Launch the app with Console filtered on `[RootTabAudit]`.
- [ ] The root is the split view: sidebar (Forum / Outils / Plus) + list + topic. There is no tab bar. The log shows `mode=sidebar`.
- [ ] Catégories → category → topic: the topic opens in the right panel. « Masquer la liste » works.
- [ ] Favoris, Messages, Bookmarks, Alertes Qualitay → topic: each opens in the detail.
- [ ] Réglages / Recherche: two-column split, no empty panel.
- [ ] Rotation portrait ↔ landscape: the split view stays. The app is never upside down.
- [ ] Navigation titles are compact (inline). Scroll a long list, then push a topic: **no hang** (iOS 27.1 workaround).
- [ ] Refresh button: the icon spins, no giant white bubble.
- [ ] Animated GIFs in a topic are sharp (not 3× too large or blurry).
- [ ] Long press on a message → the edit menu is anchored inside the detail column.
- [ ] Portrait width of the detail: readable? (screenshot)

### 3. iPhone Duo **closed** (cover screen)
- [ ] Tab bar, content edge to edge, **no black bands or letterboxing**, safe areas respected (screenshot).
- [ ] Larger Dynamic Type (Settings › Accessibility › AX3): lists and topic stay readable, nothing is cut off.
- [ ] « Rotation d'écran » set to Non: portrait lock in place. Set to Oui: landscape works.

### 4. Fold / unfold
- [ ] **Reading**: open a topic on page 3, then unfold. Note what you see (expected and known: the topic is not carried over, the split shows its empty detail). Same test the other way. No crash, no frozen screen.
- [ ] **Writing**: open the reply composer, type text, fold then unfold. The composer stays usable, closing it keeps the draft (reopen with `+`). Post, and check whether the topic refreshes (known risk: it does not after a fold).
- [ ] Fold while in landscape with the composer open: the cover screen goes back to portrait.
- [ ] Log: `splitVisibility.sizeClassChanged` / `verticalSizeClassChanged` appear, with no repeated loop of `rootMode` changes during the animation.

### 5. Non-regression
- [ ] iPad (full screen, Split View, Stage Manager): same behaviour as `master`.
- [ ] iPhone 16 and Pro Max in landscape: tab bar (not the split view).

Post the results (screenshots plus pass/fail list) on #372.

comments.body:
### Update: #372 now at `fe1e8bd` (4.0.4 build 37)
These checks replace the « known: the topic is not carried over » expectations above.

**Tests**
```sh
xcodebuild test -project SuperHFRplus.xcodeproj -scheme HFRswift -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -only-testing:HFRswiftTests/FoldHandoffStoreTests 2>&1 | grep -E "Test Case|error:|TEST (SUCCEEDED|FAILED)"
```

**Fold / unfold: the topic must follow, on the same page**
- [ ] Cover screen: Favoris → topic → go to page 3 → unfold. The split shows the same topic on page 3, with the row selected in Favoris.
- [ ] Inner display: Catégories → forum → topic → page 5 → fold. The Catégories tab shows the topic pushed on page 5. Back returns to the categories list.
- [ ] Close the topic on the cover screen (Back), wait 1 s, unfold: empty detail, the topic does **not** come back.
- [ ] Inside a topic, open an internal link (a second topic stacked), then fold or unfold: the root topic is reopened (the stacked one is not, as expected).
- [ ] Messages (MP) and Plus › Bookmarks: same round trip.
- [ ] iPad: Split View resize regular → compact → regular with a topic open: same behaviour, no regression.
- [ ] Console `[RootTabAudit] foldHandoff.rootSwap … reading=page N/M` on each fold.

**Portrait on the inner display**
- [ ] Choosing a topic hides the list (full-width topic). Rotating to landscape brings list + topic back. Rotating to portrait hides it again. The page being read is **not** reset by rotation.
